```flowproof
workflow author_critic
  needs task: text
  role author can edit
  role critic can answer
  budget at most 40 credits, 5 calls

  var change = edit author: "{task}"
  var ok = false

  repeat at most 2 until ok
    set ok = ask critic: """
      Task: {task}
      Is the latest change acceptable?
      {change}
      """ as yes/no
    if not ok
      set change = edit author: """
        The critic rejected the latest change for this task: {task}
        Revise it so it is acceptable.
        """
    end
  end

  give change
end
```

```flowproof
workflow critic_loop
  needs task: text
  role author can edit
  role critic can answer
  budget at most 5 calls

  let first = edit author: "{task}"
  var latest = first
  var approved = false

  repeat at most 2 until approved
    set approved = ask critic: """
      Task: {task}
      Is the latest change acceptable?
      Change:
      {latest.patch}
      """ as bool
    if not approved
      set latest = edit author: """
        The critic rejected the latest change for this task: {task}
        Revise it so it is acceptable.
        """
    end
  end

  give latest
end
```
